findings.scopeClassification: Latent optional witness transport; not an asserted fault in the active manual/video runtime
findings.title: L’admission des transferts witness peut dépasser sa limite pendant l’authentification asynchrone
findings.trigger: Plusieurs POST /api/backup-copy/witness/response arrivent ensemble pendant qu’un échange witness attend une réponse. Les requêtes portent la capacité native valide du PC. Toutes passent la vérification transfers.size avant que authorizeWitness ne termine son accès disque asynchrone.
findings.cause: La vérification waiters.size/transfers.size se trouve avant await identity(); la réservation transfers.add(request) arrive ensuite sans nouvelle vérification. L’état d’admission a pu changer durant l’attente.
findings.impact: Le nombre de corps collectés simultanément dépasse deux. Chaque corps est accepté jusqu’à REGISTRY_MAX_BYTES + 2048 (64 MiB + 2 KiB), puis copié et parsé. La mémoire et le nombre de lecteurs ne suivent donc plus la borne prévue, avec risque de refus de service dans le parent witness, éventuellement partagé avec l’application en mode observer. Aucune fuite ou falsification de preuve n’est démontrée. Le scénario exige une capacité native valide et l’activation explicite witness.
evidence: The pure fixture calls the actual handler with four delayed authorizations and synthetic two-byte async request bodies. All four bodies are entered concurrently; assertions pass.
A fifth request started after the four readers are registered is refused with 429, proving the existing check applies only after admission state becomes visible.
Real authorizeWitness awaits read() in server/backup/copy-service.mjs:119–122, so the await boundary is present in the production adapter, not solely an artificial fixture.
server/backup/witness-enrollment-http.mjs:63–66 performs the analogous second reader-limit check after identity, which is absent in witness-transport.

parseRecurringArguments only permits --profile for check/start-local-closures, while observer and recovery are distinct explicit commands. Normal manual/video composition does not construct this transport.
tests/witness-transport.test.mjs covers authenticated exchange, revocation, cancellation and gateway behavior, but no simultaneous pending-authorize reader admissions.
findings.confidence: high for admission race and four-reader result; memory exhaustion is inferred from the source body ceiling, not allocated or exercised
findings.suggestedCorrection: Recheck and reserve the shared admission state synchronously immediately after authentication, retaining the slot until request/body work actually settles. Cover both poll waiters and response readers with delayed-authorize concurrency cases.
findings.knownBounds: The global per-minute request budget and parent connection ceilings still exist; they do not preserve the intended two-reader bound.

crossCuttingSurfaces.trigger: A delayed response from session A fails its actor/recheck after session B has been installed in the browser.
crossCuttingSurfaces.impact: Set-Cookie expiry from the old request can erase the replacement session cookie.
evidence: 401 catch expires the cookie at line95; the archive actor recheck happens after asynchronous catalogue hashing at line81.
tests/manual-backup-http.test.mjs contains revocation-before-stream checks but no replacement-cookie ordering assertion.
Common handler race already reproduced by audit2_messaging_media; no duplicate backup fixture executed.
crossCuttingSurfaces.confidence: high as an additional source surface; shared fixture owned by auth consolidation
